Card Q&A.a: You choose 1 of your Digimon for every 2 colors your Tamers have. The target Digimon aren't affected by your opponent's Digimon's effects until their turn ends.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect do, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: This effect prevents Digimon from being affected by effects. For example, your Digmon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP."
Card Q&A.q: What does "none of your [...] Digimon are affected by your opponent's Digimon's effects" mean, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can be chosen. For example, a Digmon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be chosen for an effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can. It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. However, if an effect such as  is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can a card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect be given an effect?

Card Q&A.a: As soon as it gains the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it will no longer be affected.
Card Q&A.q: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?

Card Q&A.a: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.
Card Q&A.q: If a card has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?

Card Q&A.a: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.
Card Q&A.q: A card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?

Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, for every 2 colors your Tamers have, their Digimon's effects don't affect 1 of your Digimon.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
